items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: Formal service (förmliche Zustellung per Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) is documented on page 2 as having occurred on 21.05.2026 (Thursday), which is later than and controls over the printed letter date of 18.05.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period starts 22.05.2026. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) is Thursday 04.06.2026, which is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in Bayern. Per § 43 StPO (via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) the deadline moves to the next business day, Friday 05.06.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount once the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: This payment deadline is conditional: it only applies if no timely Einspruch is filed. If the Einspruch deadline (05.06.2026) passes unused, the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) the next day, Saturday 06.06.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Rechtskraft is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 07.06.2026. Two weeks later (§ 188 BGB) is Saturday 20.06.2026; since this falls on a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the due date to the next business day, Monday 22.06.2026. If an Einspruch is filed instead, this payment obligation does not arise on this schedule.

warnings: The payment deadline (two weeks after Rechtskraft) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 05.06.2026; if an objection is filed in time, the fine does not become final on this schedule and this payment date does not apply.

The Aktenzeichen document is dated 18.05.2026 but the attached Zustellungsurkunde shows actual delivery on 21.05.2026 — the Einspruch deadline was calculated from the later, documented delivery date; double-check this against the original envelope/Zustellungsurkunde received.

Before paying, verify the printed IBAN (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, Sparkasse Musterau) against the city's official Bußgeldstelle contact details, since fine-notice scams sometimes substitute a different payee account.
